exposure: Prematurity (very preterm vs. term gestational age)
cohort: The study included 110 newborns, divided into two groups: 66 very preterm and 44 term infants.
finding: Premature newborns exhibited significantly higher levels of IL-6, IL-8, and IL-10, and lower levels of TNF-a and TGF-b compared to term newborns, even after adjusting for maternal and peripartum factors.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken in the first 72 hours of life.
gest_age: The study included 66 very preterm and 44 term newborns.
